events.headline: Houthi forces escalate missile/drone attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities in Riyadh, Yanbu and Khurais (Oct 3-4) and renew threats against Saudi oil facilities, airports and aviation on Oct 8, warning employees to stay away from targeted sites
Bloomberg Markets Wrap (Oct 11): oil swings as Gulf shipping flows stay resilient but Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia keep supply-disruption risk elevated; dollar edges higher

Trump says the US will not attack Iran before next month's midterm elections, easing acute Iran-US war-escalation fears on Oct 10 and helping the S&P 500 rally near record highs, even as the separate Yemen/Saudi Houthi conflict continues

FOMC October 7 minutes describe inflation as elevated with limited recent progress toward the 2% target and signal broad support for another rate hike later in 2026 (no October move); September CPI due Oct 14 is seen rising to ~3.6-3.7% y/y from 3.4%, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors
